summary.text: Randy Udell is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly representing District 47 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his current term as beginning on January 6, 2025.

paragraphs.text: Randy Udell was born in Beloit, Wisconsin, graduated from Janesville Craig High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Wisconsin-Whitewater in 1983, according to Ballotpedia.

In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Udell said he is finishing his first term as the District 47 representative, previously served two years on the Dane County Board and four years on the Fitchburg City Council, and has been treasurer of the Democratic Party of Wisconsin since 2015.
He said he is retired from a 30-year career as a telecommunications engineer at AT&T.
Udell listed expanding broadband to rural and underserved areas, improving affordability and pursuing fair and nonpartisan redistricting as his key campaign messages.
He was assigned to the Financial Institutions Committee, the Forestry, Parks, and Outdoor Recreation Committee and the Insurance Committee for the 2025-2026 legislative session.
